author: J.F.Gmelin, 1789
status: 나그네새, 해마다 수만 마리 · 겨울에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)

months.note: 4~5월과 8~10월에 무리 지어 지나가고 11월과 겨울에도 드물게 기록되며, 번식지에서는 5월 하순~6월에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 우리나라에서는 흔히 보기 어려운 나그네새로, 낮은 지대의 풀밭이나 늪지 둘레에서 지낸다. 주로 곤충을 잡아먹으며, 이동할 때에는 많은 수가 무리를 짓는다. 번식지에서는 풀밭과 툰드라의 땅 위에 둥지를 틀고 한배에 알 4~5개를 낳는다.

points.en: dark grey crown to back with a faint yellow wash
pale yellow from chin to belly

points.ko: 여름깃은 연녹색 윗면, 짙은 노란 턱
points.en: breeding: pale green forehead to rump, deep yellow chin
black tail with white outer tail feathers

sexes.male: 여름깃은 아랫면이 선명한 노란색이고, 머리는 아종에 따라 회색·청회색·녹갈색이며 눈썹선 모양도 아종마다 다르다.
sexes.female: 무늬는 수컷과 같으나 전체적으로 칙칙하고 옅으며 노란색이 덜하다. 겨울깃에서는 암수 차이가 거의 없다.

young: 어린새는 윗면이 회갈색이고 아랫면은 노란색 없이 희거나 담황색이며, 멱 양옆에서 가슴까지 흑갈색 얼룩 띠가 있다. 첫 겨울깃도 노란색이 적어 대개 아래꼬리덮깃 둘레에만 남는다.

art.subject: Eastern Yellow Wagtail (Motacilla tschutschensis), adult in autumn (non-breeding) plumage, as seen on migration in Korea in September and October: crown, nape and back dark olive-grey with a faint yellowish wash; a pale supercilium above darker ear-coverts; wings blackish with narrow whitish edges forming two thin wing-bars and pale-fringed tertials; chin to belly pale yellow, brightest on the vent and undertail coverts, the breast sides washed grey; black tail with white outer tail feathers. Thin, pointed dark brown bill; dark eye; black legs with a long hind claw.
art.pose: walking on short grass, picking up insects
art.scene: Korean lowland grassland and wet pasture beside a marsh in September, during autumn migration, soft clear light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult autumn, side view walking on short grass: olive-grey upperparts with a faint yellow wash, pale supercilium, two thin whitish wing-bars, pale yellow underparts from chin to belly, black tail with white outer feathers, thin dark bill, black legs

adult male breeding, grey-headed form, side view standing: blue-grey crown and ear-coverts, white supercilium, olive-green mantle to rump, deep yellow throat and underparts (some birds white on the chin), black tail with white outer feathers, black legs

adult male breeding, green-headed form (subspecies taivana), side view standing: olive-green from forehead to rump, yellow supercilium, darker olive ear-coverts, deep yellow chin, throat and underparts, black legs
art.build: Small, slim, ground-walking wagtail with a medium-long tail, longer than a sparrow but lighter-bodied; the tail clearly shorter than in Grey Wagtail. Short neck and horizontal stance; walks quickly through short grass among grazing animals, picking up insects. Bill thin, straight and pointed, dark, a little shorter than the head. Legs medium length and black, the hind claw long and only slightly curved. Tail square-ended, black with white outer feathers. Migrates in loose flocks.
avoid: Do not paint pink legs, a blue-grey back or a very long tail; those belong to Grey Wagtail (Motacilla cinerea).
Do not paint an all-yellow head with a grey back and broad white wing-bars; that is Citrine Wagtail (Motacilla citreola).
Do not add a black throat or a black breast band; this species has no black on the underparts.
Do not make the bill thick or the legs pale; the bill is thin and dark and the legs black.
